description: This file is a build script written in JavaScript, specifically an ES Module, for managing build tasks such as cleaning up symlinks, running a build command via spawnSync, and handling errors related to unresolved imports in the build process.

methods.name: removeDistPluginNodeModulesSymlinks
methods.description: Removes symbolic links to node_modules within the extensions directory of the given root directory.

methods.name: pruneStaleRuntimeSymlinks
methods.description: Removes stale symlinks in the runtime and dist directories to clean up before build.

methods.name: findFatalUnresolvedImport
methods.description: Scans lines of build output to detect unresolved import errors outside of expected paths.
